item.tib: rig 'dzin thugs kyis rtsa rgyud drag gcod nyams su len thabs las yan lags rgyud dang bsgrubs bzhi las dbang drag lag len 'od gsal dngul gyi me longs
item.coloph: ces pa dpa' (bo) bdun bsgrub kyis (sgrub kyi) las bzhi'i nang nas dbang drag lag len dngul gyi me longs long) zhes bya ba g.yu sgra'i snang brnyan pad ma blo ldan rin po che'i bka' dang / phyag mdzod pa g.yung drung 'od zer rnams (rnam) gnyis kyi (kyis) lha yi reg bya dang / sa yi snying po sa dngos kyi brda'i bskul bas bka' ma lcogs bcog) ngor/ snyom las pa gsang sngags grags kyis bla'i sbu (lbu) ba kha ru skyags pa grogs drung yig gi (gis) gtsang chur blangs khul byas pa'i rlan thig ring (ri) mor byas pa dga' ba pad lung dgon du bris thon no//
